sentences.text: Charles Robert Redford Jr. -LRB- born August 18 , 1936 -RRB- is an American actor , director , producer , businessman , environmentalist , and philanthropist .
Redford is the founder of the Sundance Film Festival .	Sundance Film Festival	Sundance Film Festival

Redford 's career began in 1960 as a guest star on numerous TV shows , including : The Untouchables , Perry Mason , Alfred Hitchcock Presents , and The Twilight Zone , among others .	The Untouchables	The Untouchables (1959 TV series)	Perry Mason	Perry Mason (TV series)	Alfred Hitchcock Presents	Alfred Hitchcock Presents	The Twilight Zone	The Twilight Zone
He earned an Emmy nomination as Best Supporting Actor for his performance in The Voice of Charlie Pont -LRB- 1962 -RRB- .	Emmy	Emmy Awards

His greatest Broadway success was as the stuffy newlywed husband of Elizabeth Ashley in Neil Simon 's Barefoot in the Park -LRB- 1963 -RRB- .	Elizabeth Ashley	Elizabeth Ashley	Neil Simon	Neil Simon	Barefoot in the Park	Barefoot in the Park
Redford made his film debut in War Hunt -LRB- 1962 -RRB- .	War Hunt	War Hunt
His role in Inside Daisy Clover -LRB- 1965 -RRB- won him a Golden Globe for best new star .	Inside Daisy Clover	Inside Daisy Clover	Golden Globe	Golden Globe Award
He starred in Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid -LRB- 1969 -RRB- , which was a huge success and made him a major star .	Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid	Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid

In 1972 , he had a critical and box office hit with Jeremiah Johnson -LRB- 1972 -RRB- , and in 1973 had the greatest hit of his career , the blockbuster crime caper The Sting , for which he was nominated for an Academy Award .	Jeremiah Johnson	Jeremiah Johnson (film)	The Sting	The Sting
The popular and acclaimed All the President 's Men -LRB- 1976 -RRB- was a landmark film for Redford .	President	President of the United States

The first film that Redford directed , Ordinary People -LRB- 1980 -RRB- , was one of the most critically and publicly acclaimed films of the decade , winning four Oscars , and in the same year , he starred in Brubaker -LRB- 1980 -RRB- .	Ordinary People	Ordinary People	Brubaker	Brubaker	Oscars	Academy Awards

He starred in Out of Africa -LRB- 1985 -RRB- , which was an enormous critical and box office success , and won seven Oscars including Best Picture , proving to be his greatest success of the decade .	Out of Africa	Out of Africa (film)	Oscars	Academy Awards	Best Picture	Academy Award for Best Picture
He released his third film as a director , A River Runs Through It , in 1992 .	A River Runs Through It	A River Runs Through It (film)
Redford won the Academy Award for Best Director in 1981 for directing Ordinary People .	Ordinary People	Ordinary People	Academy Award for Best Director	Academy Award for Best Director

He was previously nominated for Best Actor in 1974 for his performance in The Sting , and went on to receive Best Director and Best Picture nominations in 1995 for Quiz Show .	The Sting	The Sting	Best Actor	Academy Award for Best Actor	Best Picture	Academy Award for Best Picture	Quiz Show	Quiz Show (film)
He won a second Academy Award for Lifetime Achievement in 2002 .	Lifetime Achievement	Academy Honorary Award
In 2010 , he was made a chevalier of the Légion d'Honneur .	chevalier	Legion of Honour#Classes and insignia	Légion d'Honneur	Légion d'Honneur

He has won BAFTA , Directors Guild of America , Golden Globe , and Screen Actors Guild Awards .	Golden Globe	Golden Globe Award	BAFTA	British Academy Film Awards	Directors Guild of America	Directors Guild of America Award

In April 2014 , Time magazine included Redford in their annual Time 100 as one of the `` Most Influential People in the World '' , declaring him the `` Godfather of Indie Film '' .	Time	Time (magazine)

In 2016 , President Barack Obama honored Redford with a Presidential Medal of Freedom .	President	President of the United States	Barack Obama	Barack Obama	Presidential Medal of Freedom	Presidential Medal of Freedom
